title: Two Famous Inventors
text:
Thomas Edison was a famous inventor. He worked in a small lab in New Jersey, and he made many useful things. He wanted to make the light bulb work for a long time.

Alexander Graham Bell was born in Scotland. He invented the telephone in 1876. Many people use his invention every day.

options: in a small lab in New Jersey
in a big school in London

questions.text: When did Alexander Graham Bell invent the telephone?
What can we infer about Thomas Edison from the first paragraph?
options: He wanted to help people see better at night
He did not like working with machines
He was a teacher at a large school

questions.text: What can we infer about Bell's telephone?
options: It is only kept in old museums
It is still useful for many people today
It was never sold to anyone
It is a kind of animal

vocabulary.definition: a room where scientists work and do tests
made something new for the first time
a new thing that someone has made

paragraph_translations: Томас Едісон був відомим винахідником. Він працював у маленькій лабораторії в Нью-Джерсі і створив багато корисних речей. Він хотів, щоб лампочка довго працювала.
Александр Грем Белл народився в Шотландії. Він винайшов телефон у 1876 році. Багато людей щодня користуються його винаходом.
